facts.fact_text: The applicants complained of disproportionate measures taken against them as organisers or participants of country-wide protests against corruption.
The country-wide protests against corruption were organised by Aleksey Navalnyy.
The country-wide protests against corruption organised by Aleksey Navalnyy took place on 26 March 2017.
The applicants complained of disproportionate measures taken against them as organisers or participants of country-wide protests against corruption.

The complaints regarding disproportionate measures taken against organisers or participants of the protests are referenced in Navalnyy and Others v. Russia [Committee], application nos. 25809/17 and 14 others, § 2, judgment of 4 October 2022.
